any4d-scene-flow-xz-v1.upstream_bounds: min/max after masking and possible arrow subsampling unless scene_bounds supplied; equal bounds: mag_max = mag_min + 1e-6
any4d-scene-flow-xz-v1.upstream_sampling: up to 10000 arrows; magnitude-weighted random selection, uniform random for near-zero magnitudes
any4d-scene-flow-xz-v1.unused_parameter: colormap_name='rainbow' is not read by the function body; actual colors come from HSV_to_RGB, not a rainbow lookup
any4d-scene-flow-xz-v1.comparison_adaptation: supply shared mag_min/max before sampling; same arrow locations/seed across methods; preserve complete outputs; fix coordinate frame, projection and time interval
any4d-scene-flow-xz-v1.degenerate_policy: local adaptation: separately mark invalid, near-zero magnitude and near-zero XZ projection; do not present undefined hue as meaningful direction
any4d-scene-flow-xz-v1.known_limit: XZ hue discards vertical direction; full 3D arrows or extra y-component display required when that component matters

source.scope: function confirmed; not proof that every teaser panel used this exact export path

any4d-track-x-v1.saturation_value: no extra HSV S/V remapping; do not infer constant saturation or motion-magnitude dependence
any4d-track-x-v1.temporal_assignment: one fixed RGB per track passed to rr.LineStrips3D
any4d-track-x-v1.upstream_degenerate_policy: no custom equal-bounds or invalid-value handling; follows Normalize/colormap behavior
